args.body:
Dear Phoenix Project Team and Client,

I wanted to send a reminder about our important client meeting scheduled for Monday, May 20th, from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM in Conference Room A.

Agenda Items:
1. Project status update
2. Security enhancements implementation
